visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a screen capture of a mobile app interface, specifically the EVA Air mileage summary, showing a balance of 553,460 miles. Then, a young woman with long dark hair and a white collared shirt appears in a room with warm, soft indoor lighting. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions, her hands gesturing near her face while animated gold coin graphics float around her. (2) The scene transitions to a digital screen capture of a website interface detailing mileage redemption options with photos of travelers and flight attendants. The woman reappears in a smaller frame or cutaway, pointing her finger and using her hands to emphasize the text. Yellow and white text boxes with numerical mileage data appear over her as she explains the ticket exchange process. (3) The woman continues speaking, now with a large animated Statue of Liberty and a cartoon seat icon next to her to represent a trip to New York. The background remains the same soft-lit interior. A brief cutaway shows a high-quality video of a business class airplane cabin with a lie-flat seat and a personal entertainment screen. (4) The final phase shows another screen capture of the mileage app, with animated dollar bills falling over the interface. The woman returns to the full frame, giving a thumbs up and pointing towards the viewer. The background is slightly blurred, focusing on her friendly expression and active hand gestures as the video concludes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a bright, upbeat pop BGM with a steady electronic beat. A clear 'pop' sound effect triggers as the first text bubble appears. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX marks a transition to the detailed explanation of mileage points. The speaker's tone is highly enthusiastic with a rising intonation pattern, while the BGM maintains its consistent tempo. (3) A 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the visual transition to the cabin upgrade section. The music volume swells slightly as the speaker emphasizes the word 'business class,' followed by a sparkle-like SFX to denote value. (4) The final phase features a cartoonish 'cha-ching' cash register sound effect as the topic shifts to transferring miles. The audio ends with a concluding statement and a final 'ding' chime as the music fades out quickly.
